name: ex Starter Set Pikachu ex & Pawmot

releases.name: ex Starter Set Pikachu ex & Pawmot

description.text: Starter Set ex Pikachu ex & Pawmot, released on 24 March 2023: a Lightning deck built around Pikachu ex, whose strongest attack does 220 damage and keeps its Energy on heads, with Pawmot, whose attack also does 60 damage to a Benched Pokémon. The box held a Pikachu coin, a paper playmat of its own design, damage counters and markers, a rule book and a guide, and a promo pack with one random card. The same day brought a Pikachu plush deck case and the Starter Set ex Pikachu Special Set, which held the deck with the plush case, a damage counter case, a coin and a half-size paper playmat, some in designs and colors of their own.
